messages.subject: passing variables to coord_map
parts:
Hi ggplot devs/users,

I have been using ggplot to make maps using the `coord_map` function. I am writing a custom mapping function that wraps `coord_map` and I would like some suggestions on how to pass parameters to it.

The basic problem is that coord_map calls another function, mapproj, that handles the projections. The different projections require different parameters: some projections don't need any additional parameters, some need two (lat0=10,lat1=50) and so on.   The `coord_map` function does NOT specify these parameters and I would like to copy this style as closely as possible. It seems to me the alternative is to specify ALL possible parameters and then dispatch the function on a case-by-case basis using the relevant additional parameters. This second way would pollute the funciton argument namespace with parameters that won't be used most of the time.

So what I would like to do is something like the following where I can "pass the values through" to `coord_map`.  I know this is generally frowned upon as explicit better than implicit but it seems there is a case to be made for it here. I  would appreciate your suggestions on how to do this or some other way to achieve the same result. 

```[R]
wrap_map <- function(gplot, ..., projection="",orientation=NULL){
    gmap + coord_map(...)
}

# these should both work
warp_map(gplot,projection="mercator")
wrap_map(gplot, projection="conic", lat0 = 30)
```

thanks,
zach cp
